title: Biblical Meditation
definition: Biblical Meditation is the prayerful dwelling on God's Word so truth shapes the mind, heart, worship, and obedience.
summary: Biblical Meditation is the prayerful pondering of God's Word so that truth sinks into the heart and shapes obedience.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the living Word to whom Scripture points and through whom believers receive wisdom and life.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on slow, receptive attention to Scripture. Meditation is not emptying the mind but filling it with God's truth, turning it over in prayer, memory, worship, and application. It bridges reading and obedience by allowing the Word to dwell deeply.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because hurried intake can leave truth shallow. Meditation helps believers resist distraction, anxiety, and forgetfulness by returning the mind to what God has said. It also trains the heart to delight in Scripture rather than merely scan it.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Choose a verse or passage and carry it with you through the day. Ask what it reveals, what it corrects, what it promises, and how it points to Christ. Let meditation become prayer, worship, and obedience.
